method: CSCV(Bailey-Borwein-LdP-Zhu 2017):时间轴切 S 段,遍历 C(S,S/2) 半训半测组合;训练选最佳因子,看其测试相对排名;PBO=IS-best 在 OOS 低于中位的占比。purge 切片边界防泄漏。
caveat: PBO 度量的是**因子选择的过拟合概率**(数据挖掘风险),不是方向预测。edge=片内胜率差(小样本噪声大);S=10/purge=20日为口径选择。高 PBO 是诚实信号:别相信'挑出来最好'的因子。
method_en: CSCV (Bailey-Borwein-Lopez de Prado-Zhu 2017): cut the timeline into S slices, enumerate all C(S, S/2) half-train/half-test combinations; pick the best factor on the training half, then look at its relative rank on the test half. PBO = the share of combinations where the in-sample best falls below the out-of-sample median. Slice boundaries are purged to prevent leakage.
caveat_en: PBO measures the **probability that factor selection is overfitted** (data-mining risk); it is not a directional forecast. 'edge' is the within-slice hit-rate difference (noisy on small samples); S=10 / purge=20 days are methodology choices. A high PBO is an honest warning signal: do not trust whichever factor 'came out best'.

result.verdict: PBO=42% —— 中等:样本外泛化只略好于抛硬币、远非稳健。中位 logit=0.251(中位 logit>0:典型最佳因子 OOS 仍在中位之上,故非严重过拟合)。结合 BY/DSR:仍无稳健可外推的因子 alpha。
result.verdict_en: PBO=42% — Moderate: out-of-sample generalisation is only slightly better than a coin flip, nowhere near robust. Median logit=0.251 (median logit > 0: the typical best factor still sits above the median out-of-sample, so this is not severe overfitting). Taken together with BY/DSR: still no robust, extrapolatable factor alpha.
